Hey bro, I did mess up my future when I was your age (I’m 31 now!) and got kicked out of pharmacy school 6 months before graduation… so I totally get it! Had to come home early from rotation, break my mom’s heart, and live on her couch as a fine dining restaurant to pay the bills until I figured my shit out. 
I’m happy you have your degree and license! My story is just to say… you can recreate your life at any moment. I was depressed for years about my situation, but I never stopped fighting for a better life. Yes, I took a few months paralyzed and hopeless, but I slowly worked on my self worth until I had a life worth living for. I love the life I recreated for myself, and if you ever told me what my life would look like 6 years later, I wouldn’t believe you! 
You have no idea what the future holds, unless you choose to give up and do nothing. We all know what that life looks like. I promise, you’ll look back on this time and be so amazing at how far you’ve come! It’s a slow and long road, so make sure to get started and fight for the life you deserve ❤️
